records.answer: If you are buying a resale flat, you must first qualify for the CPF Housing Grants for resale flats (Families) before you may be eligible for the EHG. You may also apply for the Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) (Families) if you meet the eligibility conditions. [CHUNK_EHG_05]

If you’re buying a resale flat from the open market, you may also be eligible for the CPF Housing Grant for Resale Flat as well as the Proximity Housing Grant. You must first qualify for the CPF Housing Grants for Resale Flats, before you may be eligible for the EHG. [CHUNK_GRANTS_07]

You may also be eligible for the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant as well as the Proximity Housing Grant. In total, eligible first-timer families can receive up to $230,000 in grants, while singles can receive up to $115,000. [CHUNK_GRANTS_11]

records.answer:
If you’re buying a new flat from HDB, the only housing grant you may be eligible for is the EHG. [CHUNK_GRANTS_07]

The Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) helps first-timer flat buyers who are buying a resale flat on the open market, to live with or near their parents/ child. [CHUNK_GRANTS_12]

To be eligible for the EHG, you must meet the following conditions: - Citizenship: Singapore Citizen, and include at least 1 other Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident in the HFE letter application - Age: At least 21 years old - Monthly household income ceiling: $9,000 - Employment: Have worked continuously for at least 12 months and are working at the time of the HFE letter application. When assessing your eligibility, HDB looks at your employment over a 12-month assessment period. This 12-month period is computed as at 2 months before the month you submit your HFE letter application. For example, if you submitted your HFE letter application in May 2025, the assessment period will be from April 2024 to March 2025. [CHUNK_GRANTS_04]
